referenceRoles.editTargets: Second chapter modern city v2: layout and architecture
referenceRoles.styleReference: First chapter harbor.png: clean large material planes and dimensional light
referenceRoles.B_CAdditionalReference: Clean city A to match the final finish

A.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production opaque portrait game background, 1024x1536. Make the SECOND chapter Lost City match the clean, dimensional hand-painted materials of the FIRST chapter coastal harbor reference.
Image roles: image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for street geometry, modern building footprints/rooflines, scale, camera, road openings and overall composition. Image 2 is STYLE/MATERIAL/LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY: its clean modern coastal structures have broad cool blue-gray shadow planes, pale clear concrete top surfaces, readable beveled edges, controlled details and coherent sunlit volume. Do not copy its sea, rocky coast or harbor layout into the city.
Keep the target's modern rectangular windows, flat roofs, ordinary offices/apartments/warehouses, irregular street edges and side setbacks. No arches, vaulted windows, grand station entrances or curved monumental ramps. Preserve a continuous quiet asphalt flight corridor and the existing top/bottom connection geometry. Same high overhead orthographic camera; no horizon, perspective vanishing point or changed scale.
RERENDER the city surfaces with large clean shape/value groups like image 2. Drastically reduce fine texture density: remove about 70% of tiny surface cracks, soot, muddy brown/grunge speckle, random stains and little mottled chips. Broad roof and wall panels should mostly read as smooth pale cool concrete with warm ivory sunlight on top planes, distinct blue-gray shaded vertical faces, crisp slab/bevel transitions and restrained blue window glass. Keep brighter clean edges where the light catches structure; never brighten everything uniformly. Avoid a flat gray wash, dirty desaturated cement noise, heavy yellow-brown patina, scratchy linework, pixel texture or photographic grunge.
The RUINED theme must remain clear through a few LARGE structural failures: a missing building corner, limited exposed floors, one broken roof edge and two or three deliberate rubble pockets. Surviving wall/roof panels should remain coherent, largely clean surfaces. Vegetation in a few readable olive/teal green clumps; no tiny weeds sprayed over every wall and square of pavement. Pavement should be quiet dark blue-gray with only several restrained major fissures and a few faded paint fragments; reduce overall crack networks and worn granular noise while retaining irregular road boundaries. Keep modern building functions recognizable.
No added clouds, fog, haze overlays, cloud shadows, cast aircraft shadows, actors, aircraft, vehicles, bullets, UI, text, logos, watermarks or transparent areas. Standalone decorative vehicles/clouds are drawn in separate layers. One final full-frame game texture.
This target is segment A, the residential/retail block. Preserve its staggered low commercial frontage, apartment windows and service courtyard while simplifying their materials.
